name: [Portal] Partner Portal menu items and sidebar icons (migration)
description:
### Summary

The Partner Portal owns a single `cms2_admin_section_map` row on master — „Portál partnera", id 2502, created by  — and the four-item sidebar in the design (Základní přehled, Moje doplňky with Přehled and Statistiky underneath, Nastavení, Obchody) does not exist in the database. This task adds the missing rows as children of that row, with localized titles and slugs, and gives each one the icon from the design. Icons are not a database concept: the admin sidebar draws them from hardcoded LESS rules keyed by the section-map row id, so the deliverable is a SQL migration plus a matching LESS block, not a schema change. The pages behind the new items stay out of scope. Two rows are already spoken for elsewhere and must be reconciled rather than duplicated — „Obchody" by  and „Moje doplňky" by the unmerged .

### Why?

The parent task assumed the portal navigation would be built as a React component. It cannot be: `NavigationMenu.tsx` ends in `return null` — it renders nothing and only attaches Inertia click handling and active-state to the Smarty-rendered sidebar (`frontend/apps/admin-web/src/Core/components/NavigationMenu/NavigationMenu.tsx`). The sidebar's only source of truth is `cms2_admin_section_map` plus `admin/templates/navigation.tpl`. So every portal screen ticket that expects a menu entry is blocked on rows existing, and each would otherwise invent its own parent and priority — which is already happening across three tickets. Doing the menu in one migration keeps ordering, parenting and the icon set coherent, and surfaces the two traps — the hardcoded submenu allowlist and the id-keyed CSS — once instead of four times.

### What?

A partner opening the admin sees „Portál partnera" in the sidebar; expanding it reveals Základní přehled, Moje doplňky, Nastavení and Obchody, and Moje doplňky expands further to Přehled and Statistiky. Each item carries the icon from the design. Items whose page is not built yet point at a placeholder rather than a 404. Everything stays hidden while the `partnerPortal` module is inactive, exactly like today's portal row. The portal keeps the standard admin chrome — the branded blue header is the sibling subtask .

### Acceptance Criteria

### Open questions

- Which glyph for „Moje doplňky"? The design shows a 2×2 grid and the icon font has no grid glyph — `@shp-layout`, `@shp-template` and `@shp-connections` are the near misses. Either accept a substitute or commission the glyph, which makes this task depend on a design-system release. For the other three, `@shp-house`, `@shp-settings` and `@shp-house-store` match the design closely.
- The SQL can resolve ids by lookup, but the CSS cannot — a LESS rule needs the literal id, so the migration's auto-increment result gets baked into a stylesheet. Ids 2502 and 2512 happen to be stable today only because migrations run in a fixed order; `docs/partner-portal/cutover-debt.md` on the  branch already records this as debt. Decide whether to pin the ids explicitly in the migration, or accept the coupling as the rest of the admin does.
- „Základní přehled" in the design is not the portal's own row: today it is a hardcoded `<li>` at `navigation.tpl:92-96` linking to the global admin home. Does the portal need its own child pointing at `PartnerPortalOverview`, or is the existing „Portál partnera" row already that item, making the child redundant?
- Frame 531:10086 nests Přehled and Statistiky under Moje doplňky, while the decision recorded on  on 2026-09-23 was to keep the portal menu flat at one level (frame 739:11678). This task deliberately follows 531:10086 — confirm the decision has changed.
- Sequencing against the unmerged  branch: it is written against the pre-move `admin/react/` path and will need a path-conflict rebase onto master. Does this migration wait for that branch to land, or go first and let 659 rebase onto it?
- Slug wording per language for the new items, to be confirmed with Partnership in the same pass as the slugs in .

### Technical notes

_Generated by Claude Opus 5, 2026-09-23_

- **There is no icon column. **`cms2_admin_section_map` (`database/schema/st_cms.sql:204-230`) has no icon field, the CRM copy (`st_crm.sql:632-656`) has none either, and `navigation.tpl` emits no icon markup. The only mechanism is the class `navigation__link--{$menuItem.id}` (`navigation.tpl:20`) matched by hardcoded LESS rules at `navigation.less:121-168` setting an icon-font glyph as `::before` content. Today's mapping: 1 house, 122 orders, 154 products, 921 group, 905/1747 cashdesk, 189 design, 1218 shoptetpay, 1449 capital, 190 marketing, 606 connections, 243 statistics, 11 settings, 303 info, 1545 parcels, 1779 sales-channels. Row 2502 has no rule, so the portal renders today with no icon.
- Known row ids, from `docs/partner-portal/cutover-debt.md`: `PartnerPortalOverview` = 2502, `AddonsOverview` = 2512, and the legacy `PartnerServiceAdd` = 1081 inheriting from `ApiPartner` = 1079 behind a different module (`apiPartner`). That module mismatch is a live bug on the 659 branch and is worth knowing before wiring „Moje doplňky" destinations here.
- Submenus are collapsed by default: `.navigation ul ul { display: none }` with `.navigation__link--active + ul { display: block }` (`navigation.less:13-23`), so children are visible only on the active branch.
- The submenu allowlist is the known trap. `navigation.tpl:52` renders the nested `<ul>` only when `in_array($menuItem.id, $triggerSubmenu) || $hasSubmenu`, `$triggerSubmenu` is a hardcoded array of 20 ids at line 3, and `$hasSubmenu` is a dead escape hatch no PHP ever sets. Referencing section-map ids as literals is established practice, not a hack — 1449, 1545 and 1779 appear both here and in migrations.
- The 542 migration is the template to copy (`migrations/2026/devrel/cms/CZ3TDR1-542/add_partner_portal_page_drop.sql`, 11 lines): one `cms2_admin_section_map` insert with `parentId = 1` and `priority = 550`, then `SET @pageId = LAST_INSERT_ID();` and five `_lng` rows. Slugs: `portal-partnera` (cs, sk), `partner-portal` (en, hu), `partnerportal` (de). Omitted columns fall back to schema defaults (`inMenu = 1`, `permissionLevel = 2`, `editableRights = 1`).
- Nesting is decided by `parentId` alone (`cms/packages/Layout/Model/BackendMap.php:302-337`); the sidebar is built by `LayoutAdminPackageHelper::getAfterHeaderSectionMap()` with `setParentId(1)` and `setLevelLimit(3)`, ordered by `priority, title`. Three levels is the ceiling, and this task uses all three.
- The module gate is double: `RequiresActiveModule` on the controller, enforced by `ControllerMiddleware::redirectIfRequiredModuleInactive()` (`cms/packages/System/Middleware/ControllerMiddleware.php:117-131`), plus `BackendMap`'s active-module filter. The `partnerPortal` module row is defined nowhere in the repo — it is created operationally via `/admin/moduly/`.
- **Paths moved. **Commit `9947faafc58e` (CZ3FRA1-133) moved `admin/react/` to `frontend/apps/admin-web/`. Older ticket text naming `admin/react/src/PartnerPortal/` is stale.
- `CODEOWNERS` (:584-588) covers `frontend/apps/admin-web/src/PartnerPortal/**` for `@shoptet/devrel-team` but not `admin/templates/navigation.tpl`, `public/cms/css/css_facelift/**` or `migrations/2026/devrel/**` — no mandatory reviewer, but both files are shared by every team's menu, so keep the diff additive.
- No Cypress or PHPUnit coverage exists for the Partner Portal today.
